summary.name: FreePBX
summary.one_liner: FreePBX is an open source, web-based GUI for managing an IP PBX (phone system) built on Asterisk.
use_cases: manage an Asterisk PBX through a web interface
connect VoIP phones and SIP trunks
connect analog phones and fax machines
add unified communications features to a phone system
summary.what_it_does: The page describes FreePBX as an open source IP PBX that gives users tools to build a phone system tailored to their needs. It is completely free to download and use and is maintained by a global developer community. Commercial modules from Sangoma and other add-ons can extend it into a Unified Communications system with softphones, paging, PhoneApps and call center bundles. Optional paid support, knowledge base resources and Sangoma hardware such as IP phones, SIPStation trunking and Vega gateways are offered. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a web-based GUI that controls and manages Asterisk, licensed GPL-2.0 and written in PHP.
notable: Web-based GUI that manages the Asterisk PBX engine
GPL-2.0 open source, written in PHP
Commercial modules and add-ons from Sangoma for Unified Communications
Optional paid support and Sangoma hardware and SIP trunking
caveats: Commercial modules, support and Sangoma hardware or SIPStation are separate paid offerings
Page does not specify system requirements or supported operating systems
